EraDef.label: sticks and stones
EraDef.description: Fire, stone tools, and the first words spoken around a hearth.

EraDef.label: agrarian
EraDef.description: Farming, storage, and permanent settlement replace the hunt and the chase.

EraDef.label: bronze age
EraDef.description: Smelting and alloying open the door to tools and weapons stone cannot match.

EraDef.label: classical
EraDef.description: Law, mathematics, and monumental building organize a civilization at scale.

EraDef.label: medieval
EraDef.description: Iron and steel, castles and cathedrals, and the long road toward gunpowder.

EraDef.label: industrial
EraDef.description: Steam, steel mills, and the factory line remake how a civilization builds.

EraDef.label: information
EraDef.description: Electronics, computing, and orbit turn a civilization's knowledge outward.

EraDef.label: exotic
EraDef.description: Beyond the authored tree: the far end of the ladder, where SimWorld's later procedural extension picks up.
